governance.bodyName: Passaic County Board of County Commissioners
governance.regularMeetings: 2nd & 4th Tuesday of each month at 5:30 PM (Administration Building, 401 Grand St, Paterson)
governance.publicCommentNotice: All meetings open to public in accordance with the Open Public Meetings Act (N.J.S.A. 10:4-6 et seq.)

whereCountyTaxesGo.details: Located in Wayne; provides specialized tuition-free secondary education to 1,220+ Clifton resident high school students at PCTI (Passaic County Technical Institute) and the STEM Academy.
Regional community college with campuses in Paterson, Passaic, and Wanaque; Clifton students receive county resident discounted tuition of $145/credit.

whereCountyTaxesGo.function: Passaic County Sheriff's Office & County Jail
whereCountyTaxesGo.details: Operates the Passaic County Jail, courthouse security at 77 Hamilton St, emergency response, K-9 units, and mutual aid patrol support to Clifton Police Department.

whereCountyTaxesGo.function: Passaic County Road Department & Bridge Infrastructure
whereCountyTaxesGo.details: Maintains 38.6 lane-miles of major county arterial roads within Clifton's borders, including paving, traffic signals, drainage catch basins, and snow removal.
Maintains Weasel Brook Park in Clifton, Garret Mountain Reservation, Rifle Camp Park, Goffle Brook Park, and Dundee Canal Historic Park.
Chief law enforcement agency of Passaic County handling felony indictments, Special Victims Unit, and appellate litigation for Clifton arrests.
County-funded operations supporting New Jersey Superior Court - Passaic Vicinage (Civil, Criminal, Family, Probation divisions).
Adjudicates all municipal property tax appeals for Clifton and the other 15 Passaic County towns; certifies annual tax rates and abstracts of ratables.
Probates wills, processes administrations of estates without wills, issues letters testamentary, and handles legal adoptions and guardianships.
Principal and interest on voter-approved and commissioner-authorized county capital bonds for roads, bridges, parks, and facility modernizations.

surrogateSatelliteInClifton.servicesProvided: Probate of Wills, Qualifications of Executors, Letters of Administration for estates without wills, Guardianships.
surrogateSatelliteInClifton.residentBenefit: Clifton residents do not need to travel to downtown Paterson to file probate paperwork; services provided directly inside Clifton City Hall.
